text:
Four power banks in the results support Qi2.2 25W wireless charging, and one more is sold only in Japan. All of them need an iPhone 16 or newer to reach 25W, and the iPhone 16e is excluded. Older iPhones get about 15W.

**Available to US shoppers**

- **Baseus PicoGo AM52 (10,000 mAh):** It is Qi2.2 certified, with 25W wireless and 45W USB-C output. It lists at $79.99 on Amazon US and is $59.99 on Baseus's own store ([Notebookcheck](https://www.notebookcheck.net/Baseus-launches-new-Qi2-2-25W-certified-10-000-mAh-power-bank-with-slim-design.1223437.0.html)). One deal site says code AM52 takes $6 off, for $53.99, and tested it in Baseus's cart on Oct 24, 2026 ([Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/baseus-picogo-am52-qi2-2-10000mah-45w)). [Buy at Baseus](https://dealectric.com/go/baseus-picogo-am52-qi2-2-10000mah-45w). That is an affiliate link, so the site earns a commission at no cost to you.
- **Anker MagGo 2 Pro (10,000 mAh):** It has Qi2.2 25W wireless, a built-in cooling fan, a display, a stand, and 45W USB-C. It costs $109.99 and is on pre-order, shipping Oct 21 to Nov 9, 2026. [Buy at Anker](https://www.anker.com/products/a110r-qi2-maggo-2-pro-magnetic-power-bank?Sort_by=Recommended&collections_anker-earth-day-sale-2026=&variant=46550444277910).
- **UGREEN MagFlow Magnetic Power Bank (25W):** UGREEN says it was the world's first Qi2.2-certified power bank, with a US launch planned for Q3 2025 on its site and Amazon ([UGREEN press release](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/ugreen-pioneers-next-gen-wireless-charging-with-magflow-25w-the-worlds-first-qi-2-2-certified-power-bank-302505385.html)). The results gave no current price or product link, so check [UGREEN's site](https://www.ugreen.com/) or Amazon for stock.
- **ESR MagSlim Power Bank (10,000 mAh):** It is 13.8 mm thick and offers Qi2 25W. ESR previewed it at CES 2026 and says it's on Amazon and ESR's site ([ESR press release](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/esr-expands-its-qi2-25w-wireless-charging-lineup-advancing-everyday-charging-at-ces-2026-302653572.html)). ESR's release says "Qi2 25W" rather than "Qi2.2", and I didn't find pricing or a direct product link.

**Japan only**

- **CIO SMARTCOBY Ex05 Wireless2.2 Pro CABLE SS10K:** It has Qi2.2 25W and a built-in 35W USB-C cable, and costs ¥8,980. It is sold through Amazon.co.jp and Rakuten, so it's not a practical option in the US ([CIO release](https://prtimes.jp/main/html/rd/p/000000665.000043212.html)).

**Which to pick:** The Baseus AM52 is the best value of the four. The Anker costs more but adds active cooling and a display, which matter if you charge while gaming or navigating.
